title: Planned water disruption – 469 Ashby Crt
body:
There is a planned water disruption at 469 Ashby Crt, Waterloo.
City Utilities will be completing a valve replacement.
Timing
Work starts at 8:00 a.m. on Thursday, November 5, 2026
Impact
low pressure, there could be no water in some areas
potential for discoloured water in impacted and surrounding areas
local traffic only
